name: Mountain Railways of India
description: Three narrow-gauge railways climb into India's hills: the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway in the east, the Nilgiri Mountain Railway in Tamil Nadu, and the Kalka–Shimla line in the north. The Nilgiri line rises from 326 m to 2,203 m over 46 km, and Kalka–Shimla winds 96 km up to a highland town. All three still carry passengers, so you can ride them today.
